Published match events and metadata: Pappalardo et al. (2019), collected by Wyscout. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Source: https://figshare.com/collections/Soccer_match_event_dataset/4415000 . Touchline extracts and classifies regular-time shots, computes geometry, and adds its own model estimates. Attribution and transformations: provenance.json. Application source code retains the repository MIT license. These historical data and model estimates are not official current football records.
